scope: Desktop production-widget screenshot routes. First specific match wins. Scene captions define variant triggers; native composition remains separate.

groups.route: Profiles > saved row > More actions > Delete
groups.exit: Current implementation has no local Cancel. Reopen Profiles through the global action to abandon confirmation; Delete is never pressed by capture.

groups.route: New Session > SSH/SFTP, or saved profile > Connect > unknown/changed host key
groups.exit: Reject/Cancel/Escape; accept only after deliberate fingerprint review. Changed keys require typed yes.

groups.route: Connect after host trust, or restore a metadata-only workspace tab requiring fresh authentication
groups.exit: Clear/cancel fresh credentials or explicitly Connect. Capture never submits a credential.

groups.route: New Session > Local/SSH/SFTP/Serial; choose destination/authentication or advanced options as captioned
groups.exit: Back/Escape returns to New Session; a deliberate valid submit starts a session outside capture.

groups.route: More actions > Profiles > New Profile, saved row or row More actions; choose the captioned edit/delete/duplicate/search action
groups.exit: Cancel discards staged edits; Save commits metadata. Dismiss row menus with Escape; deletion is separately confirmed and may be blocked by references.

groups.route: New Session > SFTP > graphical file manager, or saved SSH/SFTP profile > Open SFTP; navigate/transfer as captioned
groups.exit: Cancel collision or choose an explicit decision; Retry/Edit connection after error; close the SFTP chip to leave.

groups.route: More actions > Settings; scroll to the captioned card. Keyboard > choose action > Record shortcut or search.
groups.exit: Cancel key recording or restore its prior binding; select another chip or close Settings. Screenshot fixtures never persist changes.

groups.route: Open File > synthetic text/Markdown file > Edit/Preview/Split; perform the captioned Find/options/save/conflict/close trigger
groups.exit: Close Find/options with Escape; resolve conflicts explicitly. Final dirty close offers Save, Discard changes or Cancel.

groups.route: Remote SFTP Markdown selection opens the read-only viewer; choose Preview/Source/Contents or Viewer menu/right-click path
groups.exit: Escape dismisses one popup; Close viewer returns to its source surface. No remote reload or clipboard action is executed by capture.

groups.route: More actions > Open File; browse the synthetic ready/error directory described in the caption
groups.exit: Cancel/Escape preserves the previous surface; select a file only deliberately.

groups.route: Editor > Save As; select the captioned synthetic destination directory/name
groups.exit: Cancel/Escape leaves the document intact. Existing targets require explicit confirmation; capture never presses Save.

groups.route: More actions > About fesTerm; expand licenses or inspect the captioned synthetic updater state
groups.exit: Close/Escape returns to the prior owner; no update download, installation or restart is executed.

groups.route: More actions > Command palette or configured shortcut; filter/select category as captioned
groups.exit: Escape dismisses category popup first, then palette, restoring the exact prior viable focus owner.

groups.route: Combine live views into a pane group > Layout/Details/Rearrange/handle menu as captioned
groups.exit: Escape/Done leaves Rearrange; cancel guarded close; Separate restores independent chips without closing sessions.

groups.route: Upper window chrome > More actions or right-click the captioned session chip
groups.exit: Escape/outside click dismisses menu; no chip close/move is dispatched during capture.

groups.route: Focused terminal > palette/context menu > Bounded rectangle copy or Smart Select Paragraph
groups.exit: Escape cancels local capture/selection. Copy is separate; no clipboard is read or written during capture.

groups.route: Start a synthetic terminal > normal/history/context/Find/focus-mode or captioned lifecycle state
groups.exit: Close Find/menu with Escape; toggle Focus Mode again. Reconnect or close retained exited/disconnected history explicitly.

groups.route: Live or retained session > More actions/palette > Session inspector; expand Diagnostics
groups.exit: Close/Escape/outside click restores the prior viable focus owner without resizing the terminal.

groups.route: Live SSH > palette/shortcut > Port Forward Manager; enter the captioned mapping
groups.exit: Correct validation fields or Close/Escape. Capture does not add a forward.

groups.route: Perform the captioned close/quit/update/paste/file-drop/reset/native takeover/termination action
groups.exit: Cancel preserves the exact target and live sessions; destructive or input-producing actions require explicit confirmation and are never activated by capture.

groups.route: Open an unsupported file, or drop files onto an ineligible transport, as captioned
groups.exit: Acknowledge the open refusal; contextual notice expires. Existing sessions/documents are unchanged.

groups.route: New Session (launcher) → Dev Tunnel host card → Select a host / Find hosts (per signed-in GitHub account) → optional Refresh
groups.exit: Close the launcher tab or choose another launcher card; selecting a host only stages local metadata and never connects until Connect/Create is pressed.
groups.notes: Default and 360-point layouts plus explicit-discovery failure with retained last-listed results; synthetic account identity only.

groups.route: New Session → Dev Tunnel host card → saved host shortcut → Edit (offline host profile editor)
groups.exit: Cancel/Back discards staged edits; Save writes public metadata only and never connects.
groups.notes: Offline editor with synthetic saved host hint and session name; no discovery or authentication.

groups.route: Settings → Remote access → Allow remote access through Dev Tunnels (computer-level master switch)
groups.exit: Leave Settings; turning the switch off tears down advertised shared profiles, and nothing is enabled without the typed review/confirm.
groups.notes: Requires local-host-settings; access off and access requested with an absent synthetic host.
